description: Land Title  Settlement Department -  Borukgamuwa, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District   - Cad. Map No. 510207
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including details of land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and encumbrances. The content falls squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements.
